packages/web/server/lib/changelog/update.reason: The JavaScript's own String(value) coerces an arbitrary JSON field from the network; the value is honestly unknown and changing the stringification would change behaviour.

packages/web/server/lib/guests/html-toke.reason: The JavaScript stringifies the first query value with a template literal; rewriting it as `return first;` would change the emitted code (parity), so the template stays.
